title: Professional Services Projects: Termination Fees, Client Holds and Remobilization Figures
content:
These are the class figures of Professional Services Projects for ending an engagement early, for how long a client-caused hold may last, and for the fee charged when work resumes after a long hold.

| Figure | Assessment Engagement | Quick Start Project | Standard Project | Advanced Project | Major Project | Strategic Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cancellation fee before kickoff, as a percent of the contract value | 0 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 | 20 |
| Cancellation fee after kickoff, as a percent of the contract value not yet invoiced | 25 | 25 | 25 | 20 | 20 | 15 |
| Calendar days a client-caused hold may last before Stratton Bay may terminate or re-price | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 90 | 90 |
| Calendar days on hold after which resuming carries a remobilization fee | 14 | 14 | 14 | 21 | 30 | 30 |
| Remobilization fee for resuming after a client-caused hold longer than that number of days (USD) | 0.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 |

## Reading the figures

- The cancellation fee before kickoff is a percent of the contract value; the fee after kickoff is a percent of the part of the contract value not yet invoiced, so the two rows act on different amounts.
- The hold limit and the remobilization threshold are separate counts of calendar days on hold. On every class the remobilization threshold is shorter than the hold limit.
- An Assessment Engagement carries a cancellation fee before kickoff of 0 percent and a remobilization fee of 0.00.

Hypothetical illustration: on a Standard Project, a client-caused hold of 20 calendar days has passed the 14-day remobilization threshold but not the 45-day hold limit.
